newsitem.title: FRANCE: Brokers positive on CCF, Soc Gen.
newsitem.headline: Brokers positive on CCF, Soc Gen.

text.p: Paribas Capital Markets has issued a favourable report on bank Societe Generale, and broker Massonaud ABN Amro raised its recommendation on Credit Commercial de France (CCF), portfolio managers said on Thursday.
Paribas said Societe Generale should outperform the rest of the market by 12 percent in the medium term and recommended that clients buy the share, they said.

Massonaud raised its recommendation on CCF to buy from neutral and said its objective for the stock was 270 francs. CCF shares were up 6.5 percent at 252.20 francs at 1445 GMT, and Societe Generale shares were up 4.76 percent at 594 francs.
Paribas analyst Romain Burnand said Societe Generale's purchase of Credit du Nord would reinforce its activities in lending to individuals and small business while not damaging its ratios.
Massonaud said CCF had underperformed the market by 20 percent in the past six months.
